description: Add or remove a role across every member matching a filter. Safe to call directly: the first call returns the affected count and a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token applies the change. Walks up to 3000 members and reports if it hits the cap.

action.description: assign gives the role to every matching member; remove takes it away.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

filter.description: Which members: those holding a role, bots or not, or who joined before or after a date. Omit to match every member.

is_bot.description: true for bots only, false for people only.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: bulk_update_roles
title: Bulk update roles
